author: Praxis IV
title: Ridge + Batch‑Robust Feature Selection (keep 75% robust HVGs) — synergy test
abstract: Implements batch‑robust feature selection by selecting the top 75% HVGs robust across batches (maximizing min per‑batch variance after normalize_total+log1p), then runs the frozen ridge pipeline. Tests reviewer’s suggestion of hard feature selection synergizing with FWPCA.
